concerns.text: Task T003 (Implement real‑data loader) calls `validator.validate_session`, but the validator implementation is only provided later in Task T005. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer dependency; the validator must be implemented before the data loader.

Task T006 (Create Streamlit simulator entry point) also calls `validator.validate_session` and integrates the counterbalancing function from Task T007, yet both the validator (T005) and counterbalancing (T007) are defined after T006. Move T005 and T007 before T006.
Task T007 (Implement Latin‑Square counterbalancing) is a producer for the ordering function used by T006, but it appears after T006, violating the producer‑before‑consumer rule.

Task T015 (End‑to‑end analysis script) references the pilot gate (T016), full‑study gate (T017), methods/results markdown generation (T019), and checksum verification (T020). All of these producer tasks are listed after T015, so the analysis script would import undefined modules. Reorder to place T016, T017, T019, and T020 before T015.
Task T019 (Create methods & results markdown) is invoked by T015, yet T019 is defined later. It must be defined before T015 to satisfy the dependency.
Task T020 (Checksum verification for hand‑off) is also called by T015 but appears after it, creating a consumer‑before‑producer ordering. Move T020 before T015.
Task T016 (Pilot eligibility check) is used by T015 when `--mode pilot` is specified, but T016 is defined after T015. Place T016 before T015.
Task T017 (Full‑study recruitment gate) is used by T015 for `--mode full`, yet it is defined after T015. Move T017 before T015.
